etymology_notes: Borrowed from Sicilian allura (from Vulgar Latin ad illam horam, 'at that hour'). Functions in Maltese clausal syntax as a consecutive connective ('then, so, therefore') and in discourse as a conversational pragmatic marker.

usage_notes.en: Consecutive connective introducing a logical resolution, consequence, or sequential reaction in conversational and narrative discourse.

usage_examples.mt: It-temp kesaħ ħafna, allura ddeċidejna li nidħlu ġewwa.
usage_examples.en: The weather became very cold, so we decided to go inside.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Sicilian allura derivation established.

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian anzi ('on the contrary, rather'; ultimately from Latin ante, 'before'). In Maltese, anzi functions as an adversative and corrective connective used to rectify, intensify, or counter a preceding assertion.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni avversattiva u korrettiva użata biex tikkoreġi jew tirribatti stqarrija preċedenti, billi tafferma l-oppost b'aktar saħħa.
Użata biex tintensifika jew issaħħaħ stqarrija billi żżid grad ogħla ta' ċertezza jew importanza ma' dak li ntqal.

usage_examples.mt: Mhuwiex bniedem kburi, anzi huwa umli u ġentili ħafna ma’ kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: He is not a proud person, on the contrary he is very humble and polite with everyone.

usage_examples.mt: Ma ddejjaqx meta sema’ l-aħbar, anzi feraħ immens.
usage_examples.en: He was not annoyed when he heard the news, indeed he was extremely delighted.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; distinguished corrective from amplifying senses.

usage_notes.en: Used as an adversative and corrective connective to contradict or rectify a preceding negative assertion, or to intensify a statement by presenting a stronger alternative.
usage_notes.mt: Tiffunzjona bħala konġunzjoni avversattiva u korrettiva biex tirribatti stqarrija negattiva preċedenti, jew biex tintensifika stqarrija b’alternattiva aktar qawwija.

etymology_chain.definition: willingly, as much as one wants; even though

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Sicilian a vogghia (from Italian a voglia, 'as much as one desires'). Grammaticalized in Maltese into a subordinating concessive conjunction synonymous with għalkemm.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva konċessiva li tintroduċi fatt jew ċirkostanza li minkejja fiha xorta sseħħ l-azzjoni tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Avolja kienet tagħmel ix-xita bil-qlubija, xorta waħda ħarġu għal passiġġata.
usage_examples.en: Even though it was raining heavily, they still went out for a walk.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Sicilian etymology and concessive syntax established.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating concessive conjunction introducing a subordinate clause expressing a fact in spite of which the main clause remains true. Syntactically interchangeable with għalkemm.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva konċessiva li tintroduċi klawżola li minkejja fiha sseħħ l-azzjoni prinċipali; użata b’mod interkambjabbli ma’ għalkemm.

definitions.text_mt: Konnettiv konsekuttiv u konklużiv li jorbot żewġ partijiet biex juri riżultat loġiku, effett jew konsegwenza diretta ta' dak li sar qabel.

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian verbal particle basta ('enough, it suffices') fused with complementizer li. Functions in Maltese syntax as a conditional proviso conjunction ('provided that, as long as').

definitions.text_en: provided that, as long as, on condition that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali li tintroduċi kundizzjoni indispensabbli jew restrizzjoni li fuqha tiddependi l-validità tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating conditional conjunction expressing an essential stipulation or reservation. Also used colloquially as standalone basta with the same meaning.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali li tistabbilixxi rekwiżit essenzjali jew riżerva. Tintuża wkoll waħedha bħala basta bl-istess tifsira.

usage_examples.mt: Tista’ tissellef il-karozza, basta li ddaħħalha lura qabel id-dlam.
usage_examples.en: You can borrow the car, provided that you bring it back before dark.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; proviso syntax documented.

etymology_chain.definition: in the manner of that which would be

etymology_notes: Compound hypothetical conjunction composed of preposition bħal + complementizer li + conditional marker kieku. Functions in clausal syntax as a counterfactual comparative subordinator ('as if, as though').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva komparattiva u ipotetika li tintroduċi tqabbil ma’ sitwazzjoni fittizja jew irreali li mhix minnha.

usage_notes.en: Hypothetical comparative subordinator introducing a counterfactual comparison. Governs past or imperfective verbs to denote an unreal or simulated condition.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni komparattiva ipotetika li tintroduċi tqabbil kuntrarju għall-fatt. Tiggverna verbi fil-passat jew fl-imperfett biex turi sitwazzjoni simulata jew fittizja.

usage_examples.mt: Tkellem b’kunfidenza kbira, bħallikieku kien jaf is-soluzzjoni minn qabel.
usage_examples.en: He spoke with great confidence, as though he knew the solution beforehand.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; counterfactual comparative function established.

etymology_chain.definition: in the manner of that which (bi-ḥāli mā)

etymology_notes: Compound formed from prepositional prefix bħal (from Arabic bi-ḥāl, 'in the state, manner of') + conjunctional relativizer ma (Arabic mā). Functions as a subordinating comparative conjunction expressing equality of manner, likeness, or conformity.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva komparattiva li tintroduċi xebh, tixbieha jew qbil fil-mod kif titwettaq azzjoni ma’ oħra.

usage_examples.mt: Bħalma għedtlek ilbieraħ, ix-xogħol irid jitlesta sa tmiem il-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: Just as I told you yesterday, the work must be finished by the end of the week.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; comparative formula established without circularity.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating comparative conjunction introducing a clause of manner, likeness, or conformity. Typically followed by the indicative mood.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva komparattiva li tintroduċi klawżola ta’ mod, xebh jew qbil. Tipikament tkun segwita mill-mod indikattiv.

etymology_chain.definition: with what thing, by what means (bi- + ʾayyu + šayʾ)

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic instrumental and interrogative compound بِأَيِّ شَيْء (bi-ʾayyi šayʾ, 'by what thing, in order to'). In Maltese, biex serves as the primary subordinating purposive (final) conjunction introducing intent, goal, or consequence.

definitions.text_en: in order to, so that, to
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva finali li tintroduċi l-għan, l-iskop jew l-intenzjoni li għaliha titwettaq l-azzjoni prinċipali.
Tintroduċi klawżola subordinata wara verbi ta' rieda, kmand, ħtieġa jew bżonn.

usage_examples.mt: Qam kmieni filgħodu biex jaqbad l-ewwel tal-linja.
usage_examples.en: He got up early in the morning so that he could catch the first bus.

usage_examples.mt: Trid tistudja sew biex tgħaddi mill-eżami finali.
usage_examples.en: You need to study well in order to pass the final exam.

audit_notes: Added high-frequency purposive conjunction biex with full Arabic etymology.

usage_notes.en: Primary subordinating final (purposive) conjunction, requiring an imperfective verb in the subordinate clause to express intent or goal. Also functions as an obligatory clausal complementizer after modal and volitional predicates (e.g. ried, kellu bżonn, talab).
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni finali ewlenija li tirrikjedi verb fl-imperfett biex tesprimi skop jew għan. Tiffunzjona wkoll bħala kumplementatur klawżali obbligatorju wara verbi ta’ rieda u ħtieġa (eż. ried, kellu bżonn, talab).

etymology_chain.definition: by that which, through that (bi- + al-laḏī)

etymology_notes: Inherited compound formed from Arabic preposition bi- ('by, through') and the relative complementizer allaḏī ('that'), contracted into billi (with dialectal variant belli). In Maltese clausal grammar, it serves as a primary subordinating causal conjunction introducing an acknowledged antecedent reason, and secondarily as an instrumental manner complementizer.

definitions.text_en: since, because, inasmuch as, seeing that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi motiv, kawża magħrufa jew raġuni li fuqha tistrieħ l-istqarrija prinċipali.
Tintroduċi l-mod jew il-mezz li permezz tiegħu sseħħ l-azzjoni tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Billi kien tard ħafna, iddeċidejna li nieqfu u nkomplu l-għada filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: Since it was very late, we decided to stop and continue the next morning.

usage_examples.mt: Tgħallmu ħafna billi semgħu l-esperjenzi tal-anzjani.
usage_examples.en: They learned a lot by listening to the experiences of the elderly.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; causal subordinator distinguished from instrumental complementizer.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating causal conjunction introducing an acknowledged antecedent premise or factual explanation, and secondarily an instrumental manner complementizer followed by an imperfective or verbal noun.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi premessa magħrufa jew spjegazzjoni fattwali, kif ukoll kumplementatur strumentali tal-mod segwit minn imperfett jew nom verbali.

etymology_chain.definition: by measure of how much (bi-qiyāsi kam)

etymology_notes: Compound connective formed from noun daqs (Arabic qiyās, 'measure, size') + quantifier kemm (Arabic kam, 'how much'). Functions in comparative and consecutive syntax to denote equivalent degree ('as much as') or intensive result ('so much that').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva komparattiva li tindika grad, kwantità jew intensità daqs dik ta’ klawżola oħra.

definitions.text_en: so much that, to such an extent that
definitions.text_mt: Tintroduċi konsegwenza li tirriżulta minn grad qawwi jew eċċessiv ta’ azzjoni jew stat.

usage_examples.mt: Daqskemm kien ferħan b’dak li ġara, ma setax jorqod matul il-lejl kollu.
usage_examples.en: He was so delighted with what happened that he could not sleep all night.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; distinguished equative degree from consecutive intensity.

usage_notes.en: Functions in comparative equative clauses to denote equal quantity or degree, and in consecutive clauses to express an intensified degree that leads to a resulting consequence.
usage_notes.mt: Tintuża fi klawżoli komparattivi biex tindika kwantità jew grad ugwali, u fi klawżoli konsekuttivi biex turi grad intensiv li jwassal għal riżultat partikolari.

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Sicilian dmenti (from Late Latin dum interim, 'while meanwhile'). In Maltese syntax, dment (often reinforced as dment li) functions as both a conditional proviso ('as long as, provided that') and a temporal duration conjunction ('whilst, while').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali li tintroduċi kundizzjoni meħtieġa jew garanzija li trid tibqa’ sseħħ sabiex il-klawżola prinċipali tibqa’ valida.

definitions.text_en: whilst, while, during the time that
definitions.text_mt: Tindika medda ta’ żmien li matulha sseħħ azzjoni fl-istess ħin ma’ oħra.

usage_examples.mt: Tista’ tibqa’ toqgħod hawnhekk dment li żżomm il-post nadif u fl-ordni.
usage_examples.en: You can keep staying here as long as you keep the place clean and tidy.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Sicilian derivation documented.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating conditional and temporal conjunction, often reinforced as "dment li". In legal and formal register, it establishes a continuing proviso or simultaneous condition.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali u temporali, spiss imsaħħa bħala "dment li". Fir-reġistru formali u legali, tistabbilixxi kundizzjoni kontinwa jew simultanja.

definitions.text_en: while, at the same time as
definitions.text_mt: Tindika żewġ azzjonijiet li qed iseħħu fl-istess ħin b'mod parallel.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa baqa' jistudja d-dar, filwaqt li ħuh mar jilgħab barra.
usage_examples.en: He stayed home studying, whereas his brother went outside to play.

audit_notes: Updated ID prefix to conj-filwaqt-li; authored full Maltese definitions and examples.

usage_notes.en: Connects two clauses concurrently: in an adversative sense, it highlights a parallel contrast between two concurrent facts; in a temporal sense, it denotes simultaneous action.
usage_notes.mt: Tgħaqqad żewġ klawżoli fl-istess ħin: f’sens avversattiv turi kuntrast parallel bejn żewġ fatti, filwaqt li f’sens temporali tindika simultanjità fl-azzjoni.

etymology_chain.definition: for this, thus, on this account

etymology_notes: Compound illative connector combining preposition għal (Arabic 'alā) + demonstrative adverb hekk (Arabic hakaḏā). Functions as the standard illative conjunction introducing a consequence, inference, or deduction ('therefore, thus, so').

definitions.text_en: therefore, thus, for this reason, so
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni konklużiva u illattiva li tintroduċi konsegwenza loġika, riżultat jew deduzzjoni diretta minn dak li ġie spjegat qabel.

usage_notes.en: Illative and consecutive connective linking two propositions where the second represents a logical outcome, deduction, or result of the first.
usage_notes.mt: Konnettiv illattiv u konsekuttiv li jorbot żewġ propożizzjonijiet fejn it-tieni waħda tirrappreżenta riżultat loġiku jew deduzzjoni mill-ewwel waħda.

usage_examples.mt: L-istudenti studjaw b’attenzjoni kbira, u għalhekk kisbu riżultati eċċellenti.
usage_examples.en: The students studied with great attention, and therefore they obtained excellent results.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; illative consequence defined.

etymology_chain.definition: on what thing, for what reason (ʿalā ʾayyi šayʾ)

etymology_notes: Contracted from preposition għal + interrogative xiex (historically from Arabic عَلَى أَيِّ شَيْء ʿalā ʾayyi šayʾ, 'for what reason'). While functioning interrogatively as an adverb ('why?'), in clausal syntax it serves as the standard causal subordinating conjunction ('because').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi r-raġuni, il-kawża jew il-motiv li jispjega l-istqarrija tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Ma setax jattendi għal-laqgħa għaliex kien ma jiflaħx.
usage_examples.en: He could not attend the meeting because he was unwell.

usage_examples.mt: Irnexxew fil-proġett għaliex ħadmu flimkien b'impenn kbir.
usage_examples.en: They succeeded in the project because they worked together with great dedication.

audit_notes: Updated ID prefix to conj-għaliex; replaced generic placeholder text with causal subordinator standard.

usage_notes.en: Primary standard causal subordinator introducing an explanatory clause. Preferred in written, literary, and formal registers over conversational għax.
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali ewlenija li tintroduċi klawżola ta’ spjegazzjoni. Ippreferuta fil-kitba u fir-reġistru formali fuq għax.

etymology_chain.definition: upon how much, despite however much (ʿalā kam)

etymology_notes: Contracted from preposition għal + kemm (Arabic عَلَى كَمْ ʿalā kam, 'despite however much'). Functions as the primary subordinating concessive conjunction in Maltese.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva konċessiva li tintroduċi fatt jew ċirkostanza li minkejja fiha xorta sseħħ l-azzjoni tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Ħadem il-ġurnata kollha għalkemm kien għajjien ħafna.
usage_examples.en: He worked all day although he was very tired.

usage_examples.mt: Għalkemm għamlet ħafna xita, xorta morna dawra bil-mixi.
usage_examples.en: Although it rained heavily, we still went for a walk.

audit_notes: Eliminated placeholder tautology; added real natural usage examples.

usage_notes.en: Primary subordinating concessive conjunction in Maltese. Introduces a subordinate clause expressing an obstacle or concession that does not prevent the realization of the main proposition.
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni konċessiva ewlenija fil-Malti. Tintroduċi klawżola li tesprimi ostaklu jew fatt li minkejja fih xorta titwettaq il-propożizzjoni prinċipali.

etymology_chain.definition: on the matter of, for the sake of (ʿalā šaʾni)

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic causal compound عَلَى شَأْنِ (ʿalā šaʾni, 'on account of, for the reason of'), phonetically reduced to għax (cp. Maghrebi Arabic ʿalā šān > ʿalāš > ʿaš). In modern Maltese, għax is the high-frequency unmarked causal conjunction synonymous with għaliex, preferred in conversational and standard prose.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali komuni użata biex tintroduċi r-raġuni, il-kawża jew il-motivazzjoni ta’ dak li jkun ġie stqarut fil-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Ma ġiex għax kien ma jiflaħx.
usage_examples.en: He did not come because he was feeling unwell.

usage_examples.mt: Għaġġel, għax wasal il-ħin li nitilqu.
usage_examples.en: Hurry up, because it is time for us to leave.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; distinction with għaliex clarified.

usage_notes.en: The most frequent colloquial and general causal conjunction in Maltese. Connects a dependent reason or justification directly to the governing statement.
usage_notes.mt: L-aktar konġunzjoni kawżali frekwenti fid-diskors ġenerali u mitkellem. Tgħaqqad raġuni jew ġustifikazzjoni diretta mal-istqarrija prinċipali.

etymology_notes: Compound temporal conjunction formed from demonstrative adverb hekk (Arabic hakaḏā, 'thus, so') + comparative particle kif (Arabic kayfa, 'how, as'). Expresses immediate temporal succession.

definitions.text_en: as soon as, the moment that, directly when
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li turi azzjoni li sseħħ immedjatament wara oħra bla ebda dewmien.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating temporal conjunction expressing prompt chronological succession, emphasizing that the main action followed immediately upon the subordinate event.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li turi suċċessjoni kronoloġika immedjata, b’enfażi li l-azzjoni prinċipali seħħet mill-ewwel wara dik subordinata.

usage_examples.mt: Hekk kif fetaħ il-bieb, sema’ t-telefon idoqq.
usage_examples.en: As soon as he opened the door, he heard the telephone ringing.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; prompt temporal succession defined.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic topicalizing and adversative particle أَمَّا (ʾammā, 'as for; but'). In Maltese syntax, it functions as the standard coordinating adversative conjunction introducing a restriction, counter-expectation, or contrast.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni avversattiva użata biex tgħaqqad żewġ klawżoli u turi kuntrast, oppożizzjoni jew restrizzjoni bejn dak li ntqal qabel u dak li jsegwi.

usage_examples.mt: Ried jiġi magħna, imma ma kellux ħin biżżejjed.
usage_examples.en: He wanted to come with us, but he did not have enough time.

usage_examples.mt: It-triq kienet twila, imma l-vjaġġ kien pjaċevoli ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The road was long, but the journey was very pleasant.

audit_notes: Filled missing text_mt and usage examples; cross-linked with formal counterpart iżda.

usage_notes.en: The default coordinating adversative conjunction in Maltese. Expresses counter-expectation, contrast, or reservation between two independent or coordinated clauses.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni avversattiva formali u letterarja użata biex tintroduċi kuntrast jew oġġezzjoni għal dak li ntqal qabel; varjant aktar mirqum ta' 'imma'.

usage_examples.mt: Il-proġett kien diffiċli, iżda rnexxielhom ilestuh fil-ħin stipulat.
usage_examples.en: The project was difficult, but they succeeded in completing it in the stipulated time.

audit_notes: Added as companion formal adversative entry to primary lemma imma.

etymology_chain.definition: if it be, if it was (ʾin kāna)

etymology_notes: Inherited from the Arabic conditional construction إِنْ كَانَ (ʾin kāna, 'if it were'), contracted through dialectal syncopation into jekk (cp. Maghrebi and Sicilian Arabic in-kān > ykān > yekk).

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali li tintroduċi l-ipoteżi jew il-kundizzjoni li minnha jiddependi t-twettiq tal-azzjoni prinċipali.
Tintroduċi mistoqsija indiretta jew dubju bejn żewġ possibbiltajiet wara verbi bħal staqsa, ma jafx, jew ivverifika.

usage_examples.mt: Se mmorru l-baħar għada jekk it-temp ikun sabiħ.
usage_examples.en: We will go to the sea tomorrow if the weather is nice.

usage_examples.mt: Staqsejtu jekk kienx ġej għal-laqgħa ta' filgħaxija.
usage_examples.en: I asked him whether he was coming to the evening meeting.

audit_notes: Rigorous genus-differentia definitions for both conditional and indirect interrogative senses.

usage_notes.en: The primary realis conditional subordinator. Governs imperfective verbs for hypothetical or future possibilities, and perfective verbs for established past or factual conditions. Also introduces indirect polar questions.
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali reali ewlenija. Tirrikjedi l-imperfett għal possibbiltajiet ipotetiċi jew futuri, u l-perfett għal kundizzjonijiet fattwali. Tintroduċi wkoll mistoqsijiet indiretti.

etymology_chain.definition: if it was + thing (ʾin kāna + šayʾ)

etymology_notes: Morphologically composed of conditional conjunction jekk (from Arabic ʾin kāna) suffixed with the enclitic interrogative particle -x (from Arabic šayʾ, 'thing'). Specifically employed in embedded complement clauses following epistemic or deliberative verbs (staqsa, ma jafx, iddubita) to introduce indirect polar questions or an alternative.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva interrogattiva indiretta użata wara verbi ta’ mistoqsija, dubju jew inċertezza biex tintroduċi għażla bejn żewġ alternattivi.

usage_examples.mt: Staqsejt lil ommi jekkx nistgħu noħorġu nilagħbu barra.
usage_examples.en: I asked my mother whether we could go out to play.

usage_examples.mt: Għadni ma nafx jekkx hux ġej għada jew le.
usage_examples.en: I still do not know whether he is coming tomorrow or not.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; clitic morphology and interrogative syntax defined.

usage_notes.en: Morphologically suffixed with interrogative enclitic -x. Specifically required in embedded polar questions and clauses of epistemic doubt following verbs like staqsa, ma jafx, and ivverifika.
usage_notes.mt: Morfoloġikament suffissata bil-partiċella interrogattiva -x. Użata speċifikament fi klawżoli subordinati ta’ mistoqsija indiretta jew dubju wara verbi bħal staqsa, ma jafx u verifika.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Classical Arabic أَوْ (ʾaw, 'or'). In Maltese, the diphthong aw shifted regularly to ew (cp. lewn < lawn, mewt < mawt), producing jew.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni diżġuntiva użata biex tgħaqqad żewġ possibbiltajiet jew alternattivi fejn waħda teskludi l-oħra jew toffri għażla bejniethom.
Użata f'pari korrelattivi biex tenfasizza għażla stretta bejn żewġ possibbiltajiet biss mingħajr triq tan-nofs.

usage_examples.mt: Trid kafè jew te wara l-ikel?
usage_examples.en: Do you want coffee or tea after the meal?

usage_examples.mt: Jew tiġi magħna issa, jew tibqa' hawn waħdek.
usage_examples.en: Either you come with us now, or you stay here by yourself.

audit_notes: Added correlative jew... jew sense and validated phonetic diphthong shift.

usage_notes.en: The universal coordinating disjunctive conjunction in Maltese. Used singly to offer alternative choices or paired correlatively (jew... jew...) to signal mutually exclusive alternatives.
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni koordinattiva diżġuntiva universali fil-Malti. Tintuża waħedha biex toffri għażla jew f’pari korrelattivi (jew... jew...) biex turi alternattivi esklużivi.

etymology_chain.definition: how much, how many; as much as

etymology_notes: Inherited from Classical Arabic كَمْ (kam, 'how much, how many'). Beyond its primary interrogative and exclamative adverbial usage, kemm functions in coordinate clausal syntax as a correlative connective (kemm... u..., kemm... kif ukoll...) expressing inclusive addition ('both... and...').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva korrelattiva użata f’pari (kemm... u..., kemm... kif ukoll...) biex tgħaqqad żewġ elementi b’mod inklużiv u enfatiku.

usage_examples.mt: Għal-laqgħa attendew kemm l-għalliema kif ukoll l-istudenti.
usage_examples.en: Both the teachers and the students attended the meeting.

usage_examples.mt: Kienet tgawdi kemm il-ħbiberija u kemm ir-rispett ta’ kulħadd.
usage_examples.en: She enjoyed both the friendship and the respect of everyone.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; correlative coordination distinguished from quantifier adverb.

usage_notes.en: Used correlatively in pairs (kemm... u..., or kemm... kif ukoll...) to link two coordinated nominals or clauses with inclusive emphasis. Distinct from its interrogative and exclamative adverbial uses.
usage_notes.mt: Użata f’pari korrelattivi (kemm... u..., jew kemm... kif ukoll...) biex tgħaqqad żewġ elementi b’enfażi inklużiva. Distinta mill-użu tagħha bħala avverbju interrogattiv jew esklamattiv.

etymology_chain.definition: how many a time, if many a time

etymology_notes: Compound construction composed of quantifier kemm + article il- + noun darba. While functioning interrogatively as an adverbial idiom ('how many times?'), in clausal syntax it functions as a formal conditional conjunction meaning 'in case, if, should it happen that'.

definitions.text_en: if, in case, should it happen that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali formali użata biex tintroduċi ipoteżi, kontinġenza jew possibbiltà futura.

usage_notes.en: Formal conditional subordinator synonymous with jekk or in case. Governs an imperfective verb in the protasis to denote contingent possibility in formal and administrative prose.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali formali sinonima ta’ jekk. Teħtieġ verb fl-imperfett fil-protasi biex tesprimi possibbiltà kontinġenti fil-kitba uffiċjali.

usage_examples.mt: Kemm-il darba jkun hemm bżonn ta’ għajnuna, nitolbu l-intervent tal-awtoritajiet.
usage_examples.en: Should there be a need for assistance, we will request the authorities’ intervention.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; formal conditional protasis established.

etymology_chain.definition: so that it would be, in order that it be (kay yakūn)

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic particle compound كَيْ يَكُون (kay yakūn, 'in order that it be') or dial. kān kūn. In Maltese syntax, kieku functions specifically as the irrealis counterfactual conditional subordinator and marker, introducing hypotheses that are unfulfilled, impossible, or contrary to fact.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kondizzjonali li tintroduċi ipoteżi mhux imwettqa, irreali jew kuntrarja għall-fatt fil-passat jew fil-preżent.
Użata fil-klawżola tal-konsegwenza jew b’mod indipendenti biex tesprimi xewqa profonda jew dispjaċir dwar xi ħaġa li ma seħħitx.

usage_examples.mt: Kieku kont naf bil-quddiem, kont niġi ngħinek mill-ewwel.
usage_examples.en: Had I known in advance, I would have come to help you immediately.

usage_examples.mt: Kieku biss stajna ndawru l-arloġġ lura!
usage_examples.en: If only we could turn back the clock!

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; counterfactual conditional protasis distinguished from optative apodosis.

usage_notes.en: Marks counterfactual and irrealis conditionals. In the protasis, it governs past imperfective or pluperfect verbal constructions (e.g. kieku kont naf). In the apodosis, it marks hypothetical outcome or optative regret.
usage_notes.mt: Tmarka speċifikament kundizzjonijiet irreali jew kuntrarji għall-fatt. Fil-protasi teħtieġ verb fil-passat (eż. kieku kont naf), filwaqt li fl-apodosi tesprimi konsegwenza ipotetika jew xewqa dwar dak li ma seħħx.

etymology_notes: Compound connective combining comparative adverb kif ('as, how') with additive modal particle ukoll ('also, too'). Functions syntactically as a copulative coordinating connective denoting addition ('as well as, along with').

definitions.text_en: as well as, along with, in addition to
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva kopulattiva użata biex tgħaqqad żewġ elementi jew klawżoli b’żieda addizzjonali ma’ dak li ntqal qabel.

usage_examples.mt: Ir-rapport jagħti tagħrif dwar l-edukazzjoni, kif ukoll dwar is-saħħa pubblika.
usage_examples.en: The report provides information on education, as well as on public health.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; additive copulative syntax defined.

usage_notes.en: Copulative coordinating compound conjunction joining phrases or clauses in additive combination. Functions as a formal equivalent of standard u with added focal prominence.

etymology_chain.definition: all that which, whenever, whatever (kulla mā)

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic indefinite compound relative كُلَّمَا (kullamā, from kull + mā). Functions as a subordinating generalizing relative connective meaning 'all that, whatever, everything that'.

definitions.text_mt: Konnettiv relattiv ġeneralizzat li jintroduċi klawżola subordinata li tħaddan fiha dak kollu li hu kkonċernat mingħajr eċċezzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Qaltilhom kollma kienet taf dwar il-ġrajja.
usage_examples.en: She told them all that she knew about the event.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; generalizing relative function defined.

usage_notes.en: Generalizing relative connective functioning as a clausal complementizer of comprehensive inclusion, equivalent to kull ma or dak kollu li.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Arabic temporal and causal particle لَمَّا (lammā, 'when, since'), reduced to la (also surviving in the compound ladarba). In spoken and standard Maltese clausal syntax, la functions as a subordinating causal and conditional connective introducing a settled premise or fact ('since, seeing that, given that').

definitions.text_en: since, given that, seeing that, once
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi fatt aċċettat jew premessa stabbilita li minnha toħroġ il-konsegwenza tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: La int qiegħed hawnhekk, tista’ tgħinna nlestu x-xogħol.
usage_examples.en: Since you are here, you can help us finish the work.

usage_examples.mt: La qbilna lkoll, m’hemmx għalfejn noqogħdu nillatikaw aktar.
usage_examples.en: Seeing that we all agreed, there is no need to keep arguing any further.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; causal premise function disambiguated from negative correlative la.

usage_notes.en: Causal and conditional subordinator introducing a settled factual premise or accepted ground. Typically precedes the main clause (e.g. la int hawn, għinna). Etymologically distinct from negative la.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi premessa fattwali jew bażi aċċettata. Tipikament tippreċedi l-klawżola prinċipali (eż. la int hawn, għinna). Etimoloġikament distinta minn la negattiva.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Classical Arabic negative particle لَا (lā). In Maltese coordination, it functions as the correlative negative conjunction (la... u la..., or la... u anqas...) linking two negated items ('neither... nor...').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva negattiva użata f’pari korrelattivi (la... u la..., la... u anqas...) biex tiċħad żewġ elementi jew azzjonijiet fl-istess ħin.

usage_examples.mt: Ma ried la jiekol u la jixrob wara l-aħbar ħażina li rċieva.
usage_examples.en: He wanted neither to eat nor to drink after the bad news he received.

usage_examples.mt: La l-ewwel soluzzjoni u lanqas it-tieni ma kienu sodisfaċenti.
usage_examples.en: Neither the first solution nor the second was satisfactory.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; distinguished negative correlative la from causal la.

usage_notes.en: Negative correlative coordinator used in paired constructions (la... u la..., or la... u anqas, lanqas...) to negate two elements simultaneously. Requires negative agreement in the governing clause.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva negattiva użata f’kostruzzjonijiet imqabbla (la... u la..., jew la... u lanqas...) biex tiċħad żewġ elementi f’daqqa. Tirrikjedi qbil negattiv fil-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: La darba bdejna din it-triq, irridu nkompluha sal-aħħar.
usage_examples.en: Once we have started on this path, we must finish it to the end.

Functions as the primary declarative subordinating conjunction (complementizer) introducing that-clauses, formally distinguished from its relative pronoun usage by its syntactic position following cognitive, perceptual, or verba dicendi predicates.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva dikjarattiva użata biex tintroduċi klawżola komplementari wara verbi ta' diskors, ħsieb, perċezzjoni jew xewqa.

usage_examples.mt: Għedtilhom li r-rapport jinsab lest fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: I told them that the report is ready on the table.

usage_examples.mt: Naf sew li għandek raġun f'dak li qed tgħid.
usage_examples.en: I know well that you are right in what you are saying.

etymology_notes: Inherited compound connector combining preposition ma' (Arabic ma'a) + demonstrative dan (Arabic ḏā) + quantifier kollu (Arabic kull). Functions in clausal syntax as an adversative connective meaning 'nevertheless, nonetheless, however'.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni avversattiva u konċessiva li turi kuntrast jew oppożizzjoni ma’ dak li ntqal qabel, filwaqt li tħalli l-istqarrija valida.

usage_notes.en: Adversative connective expressing strong contrast or counter-expectation. Frequently positioned at the beginning of an independent sentence or following a semicolon.
usage_notes.mt: Konnettiv avversattiv li jesprimi kuntrast qawwi jew sorpriża. Spiss jidher fil-bidu ta’ sentenza indipendenti jew wara punt u virgola.

usage_examples.mt: Is-sitwazzjoni kienet kumplessa; madankollu, huma rnexxielhom jaslu għal soluzzjoni ġusta.
usage_examples.en: The situation was complex; nevertheless, they succeeded in reaching a fair solution.

definitions.text_en: as soon as, the moment that, directly when
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tindika suċċessjoni immedjata ħafna bejn żewġ azzjonijiet; fil-mument stess li jseħħ xi ħaġa.

usage_examples.mt: Malli wasal id-dar, ċempel lil ommu biex iserrħilha moħħha.
usage_examples.en: As soon as he arrived home, he called his mother to reassure her.

audit_notes: Added essential temporal subordinator malli with full etymology and usage examples.

usage_notes.en: Temporal subordinator expressing immediate chronological succession between two actions. Regularly triggers the perfective aspect to indicate prompt completion before the main event.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni temporali li tesprimi suċċessjoni kronoloġika immedjata bejn żewġ azzjonijiet. Tipikament tirrikjedi l-perfett biex turi tlestija immedjata qabel l-azzjoni prinċipali.

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian mentre ('while, whereas'; ultimately from Latin dum interim). Functions in Maltese as both an adversative conjunction highlighting contrast and a temporal conjunction denoting simultaneity.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni avversattiva u temporali li tindika kuntrast jew simultanjità bejn żewġ azzjonijiet li jseħħu fl-istess medda ta’ żmien.

usage_notes.en: Functions both as an adversative conjunction contrasting two concurrent states, and as a temporal conjunction indicating durational simultaneity. Synonymous with filwaqt li.
usage_notes.mt: Tiffunzjona kemm bħala konġunzjoni avversattiva li turi kuntrast bejn żewġ fatti, kif ukoll bħala konġunzjoni temporali ta’ simultanjità. Sinonima ta’ filwaqt li.

usage_examples.mt: Huwa baqa’ jaħdem fl-uffiċċju, mentri sħabu marru lura d-dar.
usage_examples.en: He remained working at the office, whereas his colleagues went back home.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Classical Arabic مَتَى (matā, 'when'). In Maltese grammar, meta serves both as the temporal interrogative adverb ('when?') and as the primary subordinating temporal conjunction introducing time clauses ('when, whenever').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali ewlenija użata biex tintroduċi l-ħin, il-mument jew iċ-ċirkostanza li fiha sseħħ l-azzjoni prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Meta waslu d-dar, sabu l-ikel lest fuq il-mejda.
usage_examples.en: When they arrived home, they found the food ready on the table.

usage_examples.mt: Ċempel lil ħuk meta jkollok ftit tal-ħin liberu.
usage_examples.en: Call your brother when you have a bit of free time.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva komparattiva użata wara aġġettivi jew avverbji komparattivi biex tintroduċi t-terminu tat-tqabbil.
Tintroduċi l-għajn jew is-sors ta’ tagħrif li minnu tkun ġejja l-informazzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vjaġġ ħa ħafna aktar ħin milli konna stennejna fil-bidu.
usage_examples.en: The journey took much more time than what we had expected initially.

usage_examples.mt: Milli nista’ nara, kollox qiegħed jimxi skont il-pjan.
usage_examples.en: From what I can see, everything is going according to plan.

definitions.text_en: since, ever since, from the time that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tindika l-bidu ta’ mument fil-passat li minnu bdiet u ssoktat azzjoni jew qagħda kontinwa.

usage_examples.mt: Mindu telaq minn Malta, ma qagħadx lura milli jikteb lill-familja tiegħu ta’ spiss.
usage_examples.en: Ever since he left Malta, he has not hesitated to write to his family frequently.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; temporal inceptive subordinator defined.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating temporal conjunction specifying the past starting boundary from which an ongoing state or activity continues. Frequently reinforced as minn mindu.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tispeċifika l-bidu ta’ mument fil-passat li minnu bdiet u ssoktat azzjoni kontinwa. Spiss imsaħħa bħala minn mindu.

etymology_notes: Compound conjunction combining substitutive preposition minflok (from minn + Sicilian locu, 'place') with relativizing clausal particle ma. Introduces an adverse substitutive clause ('instead of, rather than').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva sostituttiva li turi għażla jew azzjoni li ma seħħitx favur azzjoni oħra preferuta.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating substitutive conjunction introducing an action that is bypassed or replaced in favor of the predicate expressed in the main clause. Requires an imperfective verb.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva sostituttiva li tintroduċi azzjoni li ma saritx favur dik imwettqa fil-klawżola prinċipali. Tirrikjedi verb fl-imperfett.

usage_examples.mt: Minflok ma baqa’ d-dar jaħli l-ħin, mar jgħin lil sħabu fil-ħanut.
usage_examples.en: Instead of staying home wasting time, he went to help his friends at the shop.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; substitutive clausal syntax documented.

etymology_chain.definition: out of love, cause of that which (min ḥabbati al-laḏī)

etymology_notes: Compound conjunction formed from complex causal preposition minħabba (historically Arabic min ḥabbati, 'out of consideration or regard for') + complementizer li. Functions as a standard subordinating conjunction of cause or attribution.

definitions.text_en: because, on account of the fact that, owing to the fact that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi l-kawża diretta, il-motiv jew iċ-ċirkostanza responsabbli għall-effett tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating causal conjunction connecting an event directly to its external cause or justification. Functions identically to because or on account of the fact that.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tgħaqqad ġrajja direttament mal-kawża esterna jew mal-motivazzjoni tagħha.

usage_examples.mt: Il-vjaġġ ġie pospost minħabba li t-temp kien maltempat ħafna.
usage_examples.en: The trip was postponed because the weather was very stormy.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Arabic min ḥabbati derivation documented.

etymology_notes: Formed from preposition minkejja (from Sicilian manchè, 'although, despite'; from mancari) combined with complementizer li. Standard subordinating concessive conjunction in modern Maltese.

definitions.text_en: despite the fact that, although, even though
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva konċessiva li tintroduċi ċirkostanza avversa li minkejja fiha xorta sseħħ l-azzjoni tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating concessive conjunction introducing an obstacle, concession, or contrasting circumstance that does not prevent the outcome of the main clause. Synonymous with għalkemm and avolja.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva konċessiva li tintroduċi ostaklu jew ċirkostanza kuntrarja li ma twaqqafx il-konsegwenza tal-klawżola prinċipali. Sinonima ta’ għalkemm u avolja.

usage_examples.mt: Minkejja li ħadem iebes, ma rnexxilux itemm il-proġett kollu fil-ħin.
usage_examples.en: Despite the fact that he worked hard, he did not manage to finish the entire project on time.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Sicilian concessive origin documented.

etymology_chain.definition: on account of being, for being

etymology_notes: Formed from Italian verbal phrase per essere ('for being, on account of being') fused with Maltese clausal complementizer li. Highly common in formal, journalistic, and standard Maltese causal syntax.

definitions.text_en: since, because, seeing that, inasmuch as
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi l-fatt determinanti jew ir-raġuni ewlenija li tispjega l-istqarrija prinċipali.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating causal conjunction introducing a definitive premise or explanatory fact. Frequently opens complex periodic sentences in standard and journalistic registers.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva kawżali li tintroduċi premessa determinanti jew fatt spjegattiv. Spiss tiftaħ sentenzi kumplessi fil-ġurnaliżmu u fil-kitba standard.

usage_examples.mt: Peress li l-laqgħa tħassret, kellna nerġgħu nirranġaw l-appuntamenti kollha.
usage_examples.en: Since the meeting was cancelled, we had to rearrange all the appointments.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Italian per essere derivation documented.

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian però (from Late Latin per hoc, 'through this'). In Maltese coordinate clausal grammar, it functions as an adversative conjunction synonymous with imma, expressing contrast, concession, or reservation.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva avversattiva użata biex tintroduċi kuntrast, riżerva jew modifika għal dak li ntqal qabel.

usage_examples.mt: It-temp kien kiesaħ ħafna, però x-xemx baqgħet tiddi s-sema kollu.
usage_examples.en: The weather was very cold, however the sun kept shining all across the sky.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; corrected ID to full Maltese orthography conj-però.

usage_notes.en: Coordinating adversative conjunction introducing a contrast, qualification, or reservation against a preceding statement. Highly frequent in standard writing and media.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva avversattiva li tintroduċi kuntrast, kwalifika jew riżerva għal dak li ntqal qabel. Frekwenti ħafna fil-kitba standard u fil-midja.

etymology_notes: Inherited compound combining spatial and temporal relator qabel (Arabic qabla, 'before') with clausal relativizer ma (Arabic mā). Functions as the standard subordinating temporal conjunction introducing an anteriority clause ('before').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tintroduċi ġrajja jew azzjoni li sseħħ wara dik imsemmija fil-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_examples.mt: Aħsel idejk sew qabel ma tpoġġi fuq il-mejda biex tiekol.
usage_examples.en: Wash your hands thoroughly before you sit at the table to eat.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; anteriority temporal subordinator defined.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating temporal conjunction expressing anteriority. Requires an imperfective verb in the subordinate clause regardless of the temporal tense of the governing proposition.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tesprimi preċedenza. Tirrikjedi verb fl-imperfett fil-klawżola subordinata irrispettivament miż-żmien tal-klawżola prinċipali.

etymology_chain.definition: up to in order to (sa- + biex)

etymology_notes: Compound of directional and limitative particle sa + purposive biex. In formal, administrative, and literary Maltese, sabiex functions as the stylistic elevated equivalent of biex.

definitions.text_en: in order that, so that, to
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni finali formali u letterarja użata biex tintroduċi l-għan jew l-iskop intenzjonat; varjant aktar mirqum ta' 'biex'.

usage_examples.mt: Għamel kull sagrifiċċju sabiex uliedu jkollhom edukazzjoni mill-aqwa.
usage_examples.en: He made every sacrifice in order that his children would have the best education.

audit_notes: Added formal companion entry to biex.

usage_notes.en: Higher-register stylistic variant of purposive biex, predominant in formal prose, legislation, and religious or administrative registers. Requires an imperfective verb.
usage_notes.mt: Varjant formali u mirqum tal-konġunzjoni finali biex, dominanti fil-proża formali, fil-leġiżlazzjoni u f’testi amministrattivi. Tirrikjedi verb fl-imperfett.

etymology_chain.definition: until when, up to however long (sa- + kemm)

etymology_notes: Contracted from preposition sa ('until, up to') + kemm ('how much, how long', Arabic كَمْ kam). In clausal syntax, it functions as a temporal terminal boundary subordinator ('until') as well as a durative subordinator ('as long as').

definitions.text_en: until, up to the point when
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tindika l-limitu jew il-punt fiż-żmien li fih tieqaf azzjoni jew tibda oħra.
Tindika t-tul ta' żmien kontinwu li matulu ddum għaddejja azzjoni jew kundizzjoni.

usage_examples.mt: Stenna hawn sakemm niġi lura mill-uffiċċju.
usage_examples.en: Wait here until I return from the office.

usage_examples.mt: Sakemm għad hemm iċ-ċans, irridu nistinkaw b'kull mezz.
usage_examples.en: As long as there is still a chance, we must strive by all means.

audit_notes: Updated ID prefix from prep- to conj-; distinguished terminal and durative senses.

usage_notes.en: Functions as a terminal temporal subordinator ("until") when marking the endpoint of an action, and as a durational subordinator ("as long as") when denoting concurrent continuity.
usage_notes.mt: Tiffunzjona bħala konġunzjoni temporali terminali ("sakemm") meta turi t-tmiem ta’ azzjoni, u bħala konġunzjoni ta’ dewmien ("sakemm") meta tindika kontinwità fl-istess ħin.

etymology_chain.definition: be it, whether, both... and... (subjunctive of essere)

etymology_notes: Borrowed from Italian sia (subjunctive of essere, used correlatively as sia... sia...). In Maltese, sija functions correlatively (sija... kif ukoll..., sija... jew...) to link coordinated alternatives inclusively or disjunctively.

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva korrelattiva użata biex tgħaqqad żewġ possibbiltajiet jew entitajiet b’mod komparattiv u inklużiv.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kors huwa miftuħ għal kulħadd, sija għal min jaħdem u sija għal min jistudja.
usage_examples.en: The course is open to everyone, both for those who work and for those who study.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Italian correlative modal coordination established.

usage_notes.en: Correlative coordinating conjunction borrowed from Italian sia. Paired in series (sija... kif ukoll..., sija... jew...) to present two alternatives with equal grammatical weight.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni koordinattiva korrelattiva mislufa mit-Taljan sia. Tintuża f’pari biex tressaq żewġ alternattivi b’piż grammatikali ugwali.

etymology_notes: Inherited from Semitic proclitic copulative conjunction وَ (wa-). In Maltese, the vowel closed to u before consonants, while the consonantal prevocalic allomorph w- survives before vowel-initial words and the definite article (e.g. w-ommha, w-it-tifel).

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni kopulattiva użata biex tgħaqqad żewġ elementi sintattiċi tal-istess valur, bħal żewġ kelmiet, frażijiet jew klawżoli fl-istess sentenza.

usage_examples.mt: Ġanni u Marija marru s-suq flimkien filgħodu.
usage_examples.en: Ġanni and Marija went to the market together in the morning.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lejl w-in-nhar jitbiddlu b'ritmu regolari.
usage_examples.en: Night and day change with a regular rhythm.

audit_notes: Eliminated scraped noise 'Kunsill'; documented prevocalic w- variant.

usage_notes.en: The universal copulative coordinating conjunction in Maltese. Coordinates words, phrases, and independent clauses across all registers. Takes the proclitic form w before vowels in older orthography.
usage_notes.mt: Il-konġunzjoni koordinattiva kopulattiva universali fil-Malti. Tgħaqqad kliem, frażijiet u klawżoli indipendenti fir-reġistri kollha.

definitions.text_mt: Forma ortografika tradizzjonali jew storika ta' 'u'; konġunzjoni koordinattiva kopulattiva.

usage_examples.mt: Kienu jiktbu "ir-raġel w il-mara" f’testi eqdem minflok "u".
usage_examples.en: They used to write "ir-raġel w il-mara" in older texts instead of "u".

etymology_notes: Compound temporal conjunction combining locative and temporal relator wara (Arabic warā'a, 'behind, after') with complementizer li. Functions as the standard temporal conjunction of posteriority ('after').

definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tindika preċedenza kronoloġika ta’ azzjoni li tkun seħħet qabel l-azzjoni tal-klawżola prinċipali.

usage_notes.en: Subordinating temporal conjunction expressing posteriority. Governs a subordinate clause denoting an action that chronologically precedes the main event. Regularly takes a perfective verb.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tindika prijorità kronoloġika. Tiggverna klawżola li seħħet qabel l-azzjoni prinċipali u teħtieġ verb fil-perfett.

usage_examples.mt: Wara li temmew ix-xogħol, marru jistrieħu f’kafetterija viċin.
usage_examples.en: After they finished the work, they went to rest at a nearby cafe.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; Arabic warāʾa etymology defined.

etymology_notes: Contracted clausal conjunction from prepositional temporal phrase f'dak il-ħin or f'liema ħin (ultimately from Arabic ḥīn, 'time, moment'). In spoken and narrative Maltese, xħin is a frequent temporal subordinator synonymous with meta.

definitions.text_en: when, the moment that, at the time that
definitions.text_mt: Konġunzjoni subordinattiva temporali li tgħaqqad żewġ azzjonijiet li jseħħu fl-istess mument jew ħin eżatt.

usage_notes.en: Temporal subordinator frequent in narrative and conversational registers to pinpoint the exact moment of an occurrence. Functionally interchangeable with meta.
usage_notes.mt: Konġunzjoni temporali komuni fid-diskors narrattiv u mitkellem biex tindika l-mument preċiż ta’ ġrajja. Interkambjabbli ma’ meta.

usage_examples.mt: Xħin wasal id-dar, intebaħ li kien nesa ċ-ċwievet fuq l-iskrivanija.
usage_examples.en: When he arrived home, he realized that he had left the keys on the desk.

audit_notes: Refined to Oxford and Miklem standards; narrative temporal simultaneity defined.
